evidence.excerpt: We further introduce ReciLinkD, the first benchmark for contextual food ontology entity linking in recipes.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments show that SCODEL consistently improves three modular EL models (ReFinED, GSM-EL, and BLINK): SCODEL x BLINK achieves the highest Hit@1 on seen concepts (88.33%), while SCODEL x GSM-EL achieves the highest Hit@1 on unseen concepts (83.15%), outperforming the strongest large language model (LLM) based EL baseline in each setting.
